'''June 2000 Cookeville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cookeville, TN on 10 June 2000. [[Michael Crosby]] won it. It is known from Bill Gordon's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d870">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-10-cookeville-tn-06-10-00d870/ cookeville-tn-06-10-00], DeckTech (Bill "BRay" Gordon, 10 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-10-cookeville-tn-06-10-00d870/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Cookeville, TN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Crosby]]
